title: A face swap put my face on something above me 🙂

hook_text: At 1:05 a.m. a face swap filter put my face on something above me.

scenes.narration: At 1:05 a.m. a face swap filter put my face on something above me.
I was playing with a face swap filter. It swaps your face with whatever the camera sees. A cat. A statue. A friend.
I pointed it at the poster on my wall. The swap worked. My face, on a poster. I laughed.
Then I tilted the phone up. The filter locked onto something near the ceiling. A tiny spinning circle. Face found.
My face appeared on the screen, hanging upside down, pressed against the ceiling. It was smiling. I was not.
I lowered the phone. The ceiling looked normal. Plain white paint. Raised the phone. The face was gone from the screen.
A drop landed on the screen. Another landed on my cheek. I did not look up. I just watched the filter in the phone.
The filter had found a face again. Right behind mine. Close enough that I could feel the breath on my neck.
And the swap finished. For a moment, I could see the room from above.
So tell me. Do you look up, or keep your eyes on the phone?
